headline: HEALEY 🧳 to BEG 💍 EU Ministers to LET UK 🍆 into Industry SCHEME
text:
JOHN 🧔 HEALEY is straight up FLYING ✈️ to Dublin 🍀 this FRIDAY 📅 to EDGE 🫦 the EU finance ministers into not LOCKING 🔒 Britain out of their juicy "Made in Europe" 🏭 scheme designed to THWART 🛡️ those sneaky Chinese competition vibes 🇨🇳!! The chancellor is gonna WARN ⚠️ them not to SLAM 🚪 new barriers in front of UK firms while PUSHING 👐 for deeper partnerships on TECH 💻 defence 🛡️ and manufacturing 🏗️ all at once, according to Treasury sources spilling the TEA ☕ to the BBC 📻. Healey Daddy 🧔‍♂️ is basically begging them to LEARN 📖 from last year's collapsed defence loans talks where the UK got ghosted over how much cash 💰 we'd have to drop just to get in the club 🥂 and he's dead set on making sure this new Industrial Accelerator Act doesn't COOK 🍳 British supply chains by keeping us on the outside looking in 😤.

Treasury officials confirmed Healey wants to DIAL 🔄 down the BREXIT 💔 economic PAIN 😣 and BUILD 🧱 closer EU ties but not at ANY cost to the UK economy 📉 which is why he's laser focused on the "Made in Europe" programme currently being cooked up 🧪 by the bloc to protect manufacturing with heavy restrictions on outside goods 🚫. Former UK trade negotiator Sir Crawford Falconer dropped that the EU's first DRAFT 📝 actually let free trade partners like us slide right in but then they flipped the script 📜 and recommended locking it to EU nations ONLY which made EVERYONE hit the PANIC BUTTON 🛎️!! Sir Crawford straight up said if we can't compete on equal terms it would put the VIABILITY 🧬 of some production facilities at serious RISK ⚠️ and that's got government officials sweating bullets 💧.

Even NISSAN 🚗 dropped a bombshell earlier this year saying EU and UK manufacturing are DEEPLY INTERTWINED 🪢 and restricting eligibility for public support to EU only assembly would DAMAGE 💥 competitiveness disrupt those integrated supply chains and totally UNDERMINE 🌍 Europe's EV transition which is basically them admitting the whole thing is a HOT MESS 🔥 if Healey doesn't get in there and negotiate some BREATHING ROOM 🫁. Healey himself came out swinging with the quote that the next chapter of Britain's growth story will be written in MORE PLACES 🗺️ and to him closer ties with the EU means British businesses wherever they are based get BETTER ACCESS 🔑 to both the supply chains and the customers they need to GROW 🌱 which is peak Healey Daddy 🧔‍♂️ energy right there.

The chancellor is gonna use this Dublin meeting to zero in on TECH firms 🖥️ defence companies 🛡️ and manufacturing giants 🏭 telling everyone he wants to make sure NOTHING holds them back according to another Treasury source who's basically confirming the whole mission is about removing every last BARRIER 🚧 that Brexit left behind. This all comes after that reset summit with the EU got delayed because Sir Keir Starmer suddenly resigned as prime minister leaving the whole timetable in SHAMBLES 🥴 but Treasury sources now expect the big reset to finally pop off in November 🍂 which gives Healey plenty of time to keep stroking these negotiations like the smooth operator he is.

Just this week it emerged that Healey is already in deep TALKS 🗣️ about jumping into a global investment bank aimed at raising serious money for defence spending which is one of his biggest HEADACHES 🤕 as he gears up for the Budget in October and next year's spending review where paying for the UK's growing defence commitments is gonna be the main event 🎟️. He's considering a bid to join the Defence Security and Resilience Bank led by Canada 🇨🇦 which supporters claim would let governments borrow at lower costs to seriously BOOST 🆙 military spending and honestly after Rachel Reeves previously rejected the idea it's wild to see Healey Daddy 🧔‍♂️ circling back for round two like the absolute UNIT he is built different fr.
